content.comment_body: Hello Technical Team, I am using the [product_name] Communication Interface Module with firmware [version_no] as a relay for communications. The [product_name] Communication Interface Module operates as a Modbus RTU Master to collect data from slave devices and is also set up as a Modbus TCP Server, allowing a higher-level PLC to obtain data via Modbus TCP Client. After cycling the power, the Modbus TCP Server functionality is only available for roughly 10 seconds, after which the Modbus TCP Client cannot access data. When I configure the module as a Modbus TCP Client to actively send data to the PLC, everything works as expected. This suggests a potential problem specific to Modbus TCP Server mode on the [product_name] Communication Interface Module. Has anyone encountered this issue or can offer advice on resolving it? Thank you for your help.

analysis.insight_summary: A user describes a failure in the Modbus TCP Server functionality of the [product_name] Communication Interface Module used as a communication relay. After a power cycle, server mode ceases functioning after around 10 seconds, preventing data access via Modbus TCP Client. Client mode and Modbus RTU Master features continue to work without issues, indicating a problem isolated to server mode following a reboot.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the Modbus TCP Server function of the [product_name] Communication Interface Module to work reliably and continuously, including after a power cycle, so higher-level PLCs can always retrieve data.
